start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:follow-up-with-people-who-engaged for my Instagram and YouTube, offer a free tasting box, window 7 days, follow up with at most 5 people."
no_lists_because: It names no list of its own: it reads the records you already keep of posted pieces, people and sign-ups, and writes only people and customer steps you approve.
instructions: 1. Have records of your published pieces, your people and your sign-ups, under whatever kinds you keep them.
2. Say "Run workflow:follow-up-with-people-who-engaged" with platforms and offer; window_days (7) and most_people (10) are optional.
3. Read the drafts it shows: one short follow-up per top person, each answering their exact words, checked against your rules.
4. Approve each exact text and each new person, then send every message yourself from your own account; the AI never sends.
5. Tell it when sent; it confirms each message is visible, records the step and gives you the questions people asked.
